readmeMarkdown:
Ignis Swarm (ignis-swarm)

Contract-driven, auditable /swarm engineering workflow for Google Antigravity.
Zero external dependencies · Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows) · Node.js ≥ 20

--- ## Why Ignis Swarm? Most multi-agent setups rely on verbose personas and hope the model remembers every rule across long sessions. **`ignis-swarm`** enforces engineering rigor through **structural mechanisms** instead: - **Frozen contracts before parallel fan-out** — `/plan` locks shared types, signatures, and exclusive file ownership before `/swarm` spawns parallel workers. - **Outer-loop BDD + inner-loop TDD** — Every nuclear task starts with observable `Given / When / Then` criteria, proves a failing test first (Red → Green → Refactor), and forbids over-mocking and narrative inline comments. - **Auditable decision trails** — Technical choices (`docs/adr/ADR-NNN-*.md`) and business rules (`docs/bdr/BDR-NNN-*.md`) live in 1 file per decision with a lean `INDEX.md`, enforced by a deterministic `Stop` hook. - **Unbiased 3-lens final audit** — A read-only `blind-edge-hunter` subagent (and optional headless Claude Opus / Codex CLI runners) inspects **only the raw `git diff`** with zero access to plans or trackers, paired with an independent `@acceptance-auditor`. - **Resilient local MCP broker (`ignis-swarm_broker`)** — Supervises `stdio` and Streamable HTTP MCP servers behind 4 compact meta-tools with auto-reconnect, per-workspace pooling, local-first/global-fallback config, and spill-to-file output truncation. --- ## Prerequisites & Installation - **Google Antigravity** (App or `agy` CLI) - **Node.js `>= 20`** (powers the zero-dependency hooks and bundled MCP broker) ### Install via Antigravity CLI ```bash # Install directly from GitHub agy plugin install https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm # Or install from a local clone git clone https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm.git agy plugin install ./ignis-swarm ``` ### Verify Installation ```bash agy plugin list ``` You should see `ignis-swarm (enabled, 1.0.0)` with **10 skills, 1 agent, 1 rule, 1 MCP server, and 5 hooks**. --- ## First-Run Setup (`/ignis-onboarding`) On your first interactive session in a project workspace, `ignis-swarm` prompts you to run **`/ignis-onboarding`** (you can also run it any time to reconfigure). Subagents and `/swarm` workers never receive onboarding prompts. The wizard probes your environment (with secrets redacted) and configures 4 areas saved to `~/.ignis-broker/onboarding.json`: 1. **Managed MCP Servers** — Selectively register discovered MCP servers into `ignis-broker` without modifying your existing `~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json`. 2. **Opt-In Issue Trackers** — Choose `None` (local repo only), **Linear**, **ItsAPlan**, and/or **GitHub Issues** for Phase 0 discovery and Phase 3 ADR/BDR mirroring. 3. **Opt-In Memtrace** — Optionally enable Memtrace code-intelligence health checks and broker integration (disabled by default). 4. **Phase 4 Blind Review Routing (`reviewRouting`)** — Pick how diff-only blind audits run: - `antigravity_gemini_only` — Uses only the bundled Antigravity `blind-edge-hunter` subagent (zero external CLIs required). - `antigravity_first` — Uses `blind-edge-hunter` first, falling back to a headless external CLI (`claude` Opus or `codex` Sol) if native quota runs out. - `headless_always` — Runs `scripts/run-blind-review.mjs` directly, falling back to native only if the external CLI fails. > Deep dive into `onboarding.json` schema, CLI probing, and smoke tests: **[Getting Started & Onboarding](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki/Getting-Started-and-Onboarding)**. --- ## Day-to-Day Commands & Skills ### 1. Primary Feature Workflow (Use Native Antigravity Commands) `rules/AGENTS.md` automatically wires Antigravity's native commands to `ignis-swarm`: | Step | Command you type | What happens | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **1. Plan** | `/plan ` | Loads `ignis-plan` (Phase 0): targeted discovery, YAGNI gate, frozen contracts, atomic waves, BDD criteria, and `[ADR]`/`[BDR]` flags. | | **2. Compact** | `/compact Preserve: ...` *(pre-filled by Phase 0)* | Compacts the conversation cleanly while keeping exact wave tasks, contracts, and file ownership. | | **3. Execute** | `/swarm Execute the approved plan starting at Wave 0/1 using ignis-swarm.` | Activates Antigravity's native Swarm runtime and loads `ignis-swarm` to dispatch waves, verify each task, write ADRs/BDRs, and run the 3-lens final audit. | > [!IMPORTANT] > **Always use native `/swarm` (not `/ignis-swarm` alone) to run a swarm.** > Antigravity only activates the native Swarm message board and `swarm` tool when you invoke `/swarm` explicitly. Once `/swarm` starts, `rules/AGENTS.md` automatically loads the `ignis-swarm` coordinator playbook. ### 2. Standalone On-Demand Playbooks Call these directly whenever you don't need a full multi-wave slice: | Command | When to use it | | :--- | :--- | | **`/ignis-onboarding`** | First-run setup or reconfiguring MCP broker servers, trackers, Memtrace, or `reviewRouting`. | | **`/ignis-bug-fix`** | Standalone bugs or regressions: failing repro test first (Red), root-cause trace, `attack-the-premise` after 2 failed attempts, minimal fix, runtime proof. | | **`/ignis-investigate`** | Read-only architectural questions or incident forensics (optionally parallelized), separating **Observed**, **Inferred**, and **Unknown** facts. | | **`/ignis-benchmark`** | Methodological audit (*"Explain the Number"*) before trusting or reporting any latency, throughput, memory, or speedup claim. | ### 3. Stage Skills (Auto-Triggered & Usable Directly) These skills trigger automatically during `/plan` and `/swarm`, and also work standalone when called directly: | Command | Standalone use | | :--- | :--- | | **`/ignis-tdd-bdd`** | Implement a task with strict BDD + TDD, boundary-only mocking, and zero narrative inline comments. | | **`/ignis-review`** | Run `@verifier` checks or the 3-lens final audit (`blind-edge-hunter` + `@acceptance-auditor`) on your current diff. | | **`/ignis-audit-docs`** | Create/update `docs/adr/ADR-NNN-*.md`, `docs/bdr/BDR-NNN-*.md`, `INDEX.md`, and optional tracker links. | | **`/ignis-broker`** | Query/call managed MCP servers via `ignis-swarm_broker` or troubleshoot the broker daemon. | | **`/ignis-plan`** | Run Phase 0 planning rules directly outside Antigravity's native `/plan` UI mode. | > Full reference with examples and trigger matrix: **[Commands & Skills Reference](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki/Commands-and-Skills-Reference)**. --- ## The 5-Phase Workflow ```mermaid flowchart LR P0["Phase 0: /plan\nDiscovery · YAGNI\nFrozen Contracts · Waves"] HO["2-Step Handoff\n/compact Preserve: ...\n/swarm ..."] P12["Phases 1-2: /swarm Waves\n5-Field Nuclear Briefs\nBDD+TDD · @verifier"] P3["Phase 3: @doc-auditor\n1-File ADRs/BDRs\nINDEX.md · Opt-In Sync"] P4["Phase 4: 3-Lens Audit\nblind-edge-hunter (diff-only)\n@acceptance-auditor"] P5["Phase 5: Closure\nSummary & Final /compact"] P0 --> HO --> P12 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 ``` 1. **Phase 0 (`/plan`):** Maps callers/callees and `docs/{adr,bdr}/INDEX.md`, cuts dead weight (`subtract-before-you-add`) and speculative work (YAGNI), freezes shared contracts (Wave 0), and splits work into non-colliding waves with exclusive file ownership. 2. **Phases 1–2 (`/swarm` Coordinator + Workers):** Dispatches 1 named worker per nuclear task using a strict 5-field brief and capability-tier model routing; pairs waves with `@verifier` (Red → Green proof, scope check, anti-mock check, factual coverage) and pauses for `/compact` at wave boundaries when context pressure rises. 3. **Phase 3 (`@doc-auditor`):** Writes 1 file per `[ADR]`/`[BDR]` decision, updates `INDEX.md`, and optionally mirrors links/comments into your connected issue tracker. 4. **Phase 4 (3-Lens Final Audit):** Combines **`blind-edge-hunter`** (strictly diff-only, read-only, `inheritMcp: false`, `model: pro`, or headless Claude/Codex via `scripts/run-blind-review.mjs`) with **`@acceptance-auditor`** (full access to plan, tracker, and ADRs/BDRs). 5. **Phase 5 (Closure):** Fixes proven `HIGH`/`MEDIUM` findings, reports observed coverage and audit verdicts, and emits a pre-filled post-slice `/compact` checkpoint. > Detailed walkthrough, brief templates, model routing, and compaction checkpoints: **[Five-Phase Swarm Workflow](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki/Five-Phase-Swarm-Workflow)**. --- ## Built-In Resilience & Safety at a Glance ### Resilient MCP Broker (`ignis-swarm_broker`) Exposes **4 compact meta-tools** (`broker_list`, `broker_describe`, `broker_call`, `broker_status`) backed by a detached localhost Node.js daemon with lazy auto-start, crash recovery, per-workspace pooling, local-first (`.agents/ignis-broker.json`) + global-fallback (`~/.ignis-broker/servers.json`) config, `${VAR}` secret expansion from `~/.ignis-broker/.env`, and spill-to-file output truncation. ```bash # Quick CLI diagnostics node scripts/ignis-broker.mjs status node scripts/ignis-broker.mjs discover-mcp ``` ### Automatic Lifecycle Hooks (`hooks.json`) | Hook | What it does automatically | | :--- | :--- | | **`SessionStart`** | Prompts first-run onboarding (main session only), detects `docs/{adr,bdr}/INDEX.md`, warns on local broker config errors/fallbacks, and checks opt-in Memtrace health. | | **`PreToolUse`** | Blocks `--no-verify`, force-push to `main`/`master`, `git reset --hard`, and destructive root deletions; asks confirmation before other force pushes or `git clean -f`. | | **`PostToolUse`** | Logs lightweight per-conversation JSONL audit entries (`~/.ignis-broker/audit/.jsonl`) and tags test executions. | | **`PostInvocation`** | Deterministic `compaction-watch.mjs` monitors active transcript size (default `550 KB`) and prompts a pre-filled `/compact` checkpoint. | | **`Stop`** | Blocks finishing if any `ADR-NNN`/`BDR-NNN` file is missing from `INDEX.md` or if added git diff lines contain `.only`, `.skip`, `#[ignore]`, `t.Skip`, `@ts-ignore`, `eslint-disable`, bare `// nolint`, or new `TODO`/`FIXME`. | --- ## Full Documentation (GitHub Wiki) Detailed guides, schemas, CLI flags, environment variables, and troubleshooting live in the **[GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki)**: | Wiki Page | What you'll find | | :--- | :--- | | **[Home](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki)** | Documentation map by role and task | | **[Getting Started & Onboarding](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki/Getting-Started-and-Onboarding)** | Install methods, Q1–Q5 wizard walkthrough, `onboarding.json` schema, CLI management | | **[Commands & Skills Reference](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki/Commands-and-Skills-Reference)** | All 10 skills, native `/plan` & `/swarm` rules, triggers, and standalone examples | | **[Five-Phase Swarm Workflow](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki/Five-Phase-Swarm-Workflow)** | Wave anatomy, 5-field nuclear brief, model routing tiers, compaction checkpoints | | **[TDD/BDD & Audit Documentation](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki/TDD-BDD-and-Audit-Documentation)** | BDD+TDD loop, anti-Goodhart rules, mutation testing, ADR/BDR templates, tracker profiles | | **[Blind Review & Final Audit](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki/Blind-Review-and-Final-Audit)** | `@verifier`, `blind-edge-hunter`, `run-blind-review.mjs` (Claude Opus & Codex Sol), `@acceptance-auditor` | | **[Resilient MCP Broker](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki/Resilient-MCP-Broker)** | Architecture, 4 meta-tools, all 14 CLI commands, config precedence, `.env` secrets, spill-to-file | | **[Lifecycle Hooks & Guardrails](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki/Lifecycle-Hooks-and-Guardrails)** | Exact rules for all 5 hooks, audit logs, and all environment variables | | **[Architecture, Troubleshooting & FAQ](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki/Architecture-Troubleshooting-and-FAQ)** | 8 engineering principles, ADR index, common issues & fixes, FAQ | --- ## Validation, Tests & Architecture Decisions ```bash # Strict Antigravity plugin validation agy plugin validate --strict . # Full automated test suite (hooks, broker unit/supervisor/E2E, onboarding, blind-review runner) node --test tests/*.test.mjs ``` - Architecture Decision Records: [docs/adr/INDEX.md](docs/adr/INDEX.md) ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 [magalz](https://github.com/magalz)
latestReleaseNotes:
Initial public release of **ignis-swarm** — a zero-dependency, cross-platform, contract-driven \/swarm\ engineering workflow plugin for Google Antigravity.

### Highlights
- **5-Phase Workflow:** \/plan\ (Phase 0) -> 2-step \/compact\ + \/swarm\ handoff -> atomic wave execution with 5-field nuclear briefs -> \@doc-auditor\ ADRs/BDRs -> 3-lens final audit (\ lind-edge-hunter\ + \@acceptance-auditor\).
- **10 Skills, 1 Custom Subagent, 1 Rule, 5 Lifecycle Hooks:** Zero external dependencies (Node.js >= 20).
- **Resilient Local MCP Broker (\ignis-swarm_broker\):** 4 compact meta-tools, detached auto-start daemon, local-first/global-fallback config, per-workspace pooling, Windows \.cmd\ shim support, and spill-to-file truncation.
- **Full Documentation:** See the [GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/magalz/ignis-swarm/wiki).
